features: <actions string="Two Actions" /> The phantom walks the thin line between the [Ethereal](/Equipment.aspx?ID=284) and [Material Planes](/Planes.aspx?ID=1) in order to exist on both planes simultaneously. They can shift back to solely the Ethereal Plane by using this ability again.
all damage 2 (except [force](/Traits.aspx?ID=75) or [_ghost touch_](/Equipment.aspx?ID=297); double resistance vs. non-[magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=103))

Though phantoms aren't alive, neither are they [undead](/Traits.aspx?ID=160), and they are uniquely vulnerable to the effects of death. A phantom whose Hit Points are reduced to 0 as a result of a [death](/Traits.aspx?ID=40) effect (such as from a spell like [_finger of death_](/Spells.aspx?ID=116)) is immediately whisked away to the River of Souls, where their soul resumes the usual path to the afterlife.

Any creature within 30 feet that the phantom can see and hear can issue a calm and friendly greeting to it as a two-action activity with the [auditory](/Traits.aspx?ID=16), [concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32), [linguistic](/Traits.aspx?ID=101), and [mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=106) traits. A creature greeting the phantom in this manner must attempt a DC 17 [Diplomacy](/Skills.aspx?ID=6) check.
The phantom takes 4d8 mental damage and is [stunned 1](/Conditions.aspx?ID=36).
The phantom is unaffected, and is not affected by this weakness for 1 round.
The phantom wolf's Strikes deal an additional 1d4 damage to creatures within reach of at least one of its allies.
